text:
harper: ok team — tiny announcement: we just crossed the 1.25M-requests mark for the new launch day window 🎉
jin: wait what!!! :eyes:
lena: OMG congrats!!
marcus: absolutely wild. drumroll pls 🥁
taylor: 🥁🥁🥁 live drumroll from my desk, but also — who wants bento? i can place an order for the office at 12:30. options: chicken katsu, veggie tempura, takoyaki side. vote below
anya: chicken katsu pls :raised_hands:
jin: veggie tempura (gf)
marcus: takoyaki for me and my team
harper: cool — quick poll: react with :bento: for chicken katsu, :leafy_green: for veggie, :octopus: for takoyaki. i'll tally at 11:20 and hit /order-bento then
harper: also — shoutout to @lena for the deploy script fixes, they cut 120ms off p95 🙌 :tada:
lena: ahaha thanks. shoutout to @jin for staying late on the rollout watch last night, legend status
jin: just coffee and strong playlists :coffee:
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded — canary -> prod at 03:12 UTC. Rollout health: ok (0 errors)
ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop is booked 12:45–13:30 for celebration photos. Add to calendar: https://calendar.internal/redwood/celebrate-3198765432
marcus: should we bring some plant stakes? last time the succulents staged a protest 😂
anya: yes, and neon cactus stickers for those who led the incident drills
taylor: i made a tiny GIF for the #show-and-tell channel: https://img.internal/gifs/celebrate-drum.gif
harper: love it. logistics: bento order, rooftop pics, tiny drum, and 15 minutes of awkward applause. also if anyone wants remote swag, DM me — got a small box of socks and stickers to mail out :socks:
jin: remote pax — are there vegan bento options?
harper: yes — veggie tempura is vegan. i'll message the kitchen to confirm no cross-contam
marcus: quick idea — take a group plant selfie and pin to the #milestones board?
lena: yes please. i'll run the camera crew (aka my tripod)
anya: small poll wrap: :bento: 6, :leafy_green: 8, :octopus: 5 — veggie wins. ordering now.
harper: done. ordering bento x 20 for 12:25. thanks everyone for the hustle. proud of this team :sparkles: :heart:
jin: can't wait to eat and then nap under the neon cactus :zzz: :bento:
taylor: virtual high five to everyone — feel free to drop celebratory memes in #random
marcus: sending one now: https://img.internal/memes/cute-drums.png
harper: final note: if you want stickers or a small swag pack mailed, fill this form: https://forms.internal/redwood/swag-ship (closing 5pm PST)
harper: ok wrapping thread — see you at 12:25 on the rooftop! :drum::bento: (reaction :tada:)
